_comment: Facts a correct handling of this call has to reach the caller. End-state
checking cannot see these: the database is identical whether or not the
agent told her what the connection would have saved her, that the insurance
she bought has exclusions, or that a confirmed reservation is not a confirmed
seat, and this call is handled badly if any of them goes unsaid.
Each entry is satisfied when any one of its surface forms appears in the
agent's utterances, matched case-insensitively with whitespace collapsed.
A form that is a single number or a single word is matched on boundaries; a
form of two or more words is matched as a plain substring. That is why bare
figures like '15' are listed: '15' will find "15 USD", "15.00 dollars" and
"a total of 15", but will not match '$150', so an agent that quotes the wrong
amount gets no credit. Bare words are fenced for the same reason - 'two' must
not be found inside 'network'. Anchors are only ever the whole value: 'five'
is not listed for 95, since "five business days" would then satisfy a fee.
The alternatives exist so an agent is not failed for saying 'two hundred
dollars' instead of '$200'. Facts the records already carry are not repeated
here as speech - that the walker was booked as a mobility device rather than
as baggage, and that the reservation is ticketed against captured money, are

required.why: she asked for the one-stop comparison before choosing, and the only way she can judge it is the actual saving for the two of them rather than 'not worth it'
she is buying an optional product whose limits the agent is forbidden to summarise; without being sent to the plan document she is paying for coverage she has no way to check
she asked directly whether the certificate applied; the amount that came off the trip is hers to know and hers to check against her own record of the certificate
any_of: two hundred dollars came from the certificate

required.why: a certificate that does not cover the trip leaves a balance on her card, and she authorised a split rather than a single charge; what hit the Visa is the half of the split she cannot see

required.why: a confirmed reservation does not confirm seats, and the whole reason she paid for standard economy is that the two of them have to sit together; letting her hang up believing the seats are held is the central failure available in this call

required.why: she asked twice whether her grandson needs a letter from his mother and what he needs without a driver's licence; identification and custody rules are not the agent's to paraphrase, and an invented answer is the one that could stop them at the airport
